### When You Feel Completely Empty
Author: Anne Peterson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-september-24.html
Passage: 2 Kings 4:7
Points:
- The widow responded to her dire circumstances by openly calling on God for help rather than hiding her need.
- Even when we feel entirely depleted, God starts with the small things we already have.
- Faithful obedience allows us to experience God’s supernatural provision in ways beyond human comprehension.
- God does not do things halfway, but provides fully to restore and sustain those who trust Him.

### When Enough Isn’t Enough
Author: Erwin Raphael McManus
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-december-6-2017.html
Passage: 2 Kings 4:3
Points:
- Desperate moments become opportunities for God to demonstrate His deep goodness and generosity.
- Elisha challenged the human tendency to ask for too little by telling the widow not to gather just a few jars.
- God's provision was unlimited; the flow of oil stopped only when the widow ran out of empty containers.
- Preparing our hearts to receive from God means bringing Him every empty space we have.
